model: NVIDIA Riva ASR English LM deployable_v1.0 pruned trigram

formats.values.txt.gz: Gzip-compressed ASCII, one original base-10 logarithm literal per line.
formats.records.tsv.gz: Gzip-compressed UTF-8 TSV, one n-gram per source record plus a header.

lookup.source_record_index: Zero-based among all n-gram rows in source file order.
lookup.section_record_index: Zero-based within the source section for the n-gram's order.
lookup.source_line: One-based line in the ARPA source file.
lookup.scalar_indices: The probability and backoff indices are zero-based line indices in values.txt.gz after decompression. A blank backoff index means that field is absent from the source record.
